title: Partitions in this environment
prompt: What does this program print in this environment? `trips` is read from one small CSV file.
program:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

short = trips.filter(F.col("trip_distance") < 3).select("trip_id", "fare")
print(trips.rdd.getNumPartitions(), short.rdd.getNumPartitions())
print(spark.sparkContext.defaultParallelism)
print(spark.conf.get("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions"))
hints: A small file is read as one partition.
`filter` and `select` are narrow: each partition becomes one partition of the result.
This environment is Spark in local mode with two cores, and it sets the shuffle partitions to 4 instead of Spark's usual 200.
